name: Genesis Proyect
source:
Angels, demons, and humans… were never meant to coexist in harmony.

In a world where a mysterious virus has driven men to the brink of extinction, the protagonist has only one goal: to uncover the truth behind his father’s murder. But in a reality ruled by supernatural forces, justice does not come easily.

The Queen of Demons offers him her help… under one condition.

“You will enter my Celestial Academy… and you will satisfy my students.”

Thus begins his journey into an institution where nothing is as it seems. Among beautiful and enigmatic students, dark secrets and hidden desires, he will discover that the so-called Celestial Academy is anything but heavenly…

Because in truth, it is a demonic academy.

And the real hell is only just beginning.

translation:
天使、恶魔、人类……本来就不应该和谐共处。

在一个神秘病毒将人类逼向灭绝的世界里，主角只有一个目标：揭开父亲被谋杀的真相。但在超自然力量统治的现实中，正义并不容易到来。

恶魔女王向他提供帮助……但有一个条件。

“你会进入我的仙院……让我的学生满意。”

就这样，他开始了进入一个机构的旅程，那里的一切都不像看上去的那样。在美丽而神秘的学生、黑暗的秘密和隐藏的欲望中，他会发现所谓的仙院根本不是天堂……

因为事实上，这是一所恶魔学院。

而真正的地狱才刚刚开始。
